title: Atomic Habits — 1% daily improvement loop
description: A composite loop that observes the agent's recent work, identifies one 1% improvement, ships it, and verifies it landed. Runs nightly.
prompt: Review the agent's recent work from today. Identify exactly ONE small (1%) improvement: a missing skill step, a documentation gap, a stale fixture, or a minor code quality issue. Ship the fix. Verify it landed.
